services.name: Marina City Pontoon
services.desc: DEPARTS FROM THE MARINA CITY LOCATION* If you love to feel the sun on your face, then our Pontoon Boat is the one for you! At 21 feet in length, this boat has plenty of comfortable seating, including a booth-like set up around a table at the bow. Like all of our boats, our Pontoon boats come complete with non-skid woven floors, USCG required safety equipment, plush seats with backrest cushions, a radio and auxiliary cord and 2 sturdy tables with cup holders. Our waivers are digital and therefore 100% paperless. We recommend that you fill out the waiver before your trip in order to save time during the check-in process. Arrive at least 30 minutes early-your reservation time is when we hit

includes: Safety video and 5-10 minute tutorial from expert crew before departure
Detailed map for planning cruise along the river
gap: Cancellation and refund policy not stated
blurb: Guests rent electric boats to cruise the Chicago River or Lake Michigan. Boats include picnic-style Duffys, pontoons, vintage retro boats, and luxury yachts. Drivers must be 21+, have a valid driver's license, and receive a safety tutorial before departure.
extraNote: USCG licensed captains available for $75/hour with minimum 2 hours, must be reserved beforehand · If hiring a captain, only 6 passengers permitted on the boat per USCG law · Multiple locations including Marina City Downtown, City Winery Downtown, Chicago Water Plaza Downtown, Rockwell North Branch, and Chicago Lakefront on Lake Michigan.
